subject: Agile Deliberation status: index built, early pilot signal
body:
Hi Dmitri, Bao,

Status. Index is built — setup.sh reproduces the file layout and the FAISS index over the training slice, and Demo.ipynb runs end to end on the internal mirror. Early pilot signal is genuinely encouraging: surfacing borderline examples for reflection moved inter-rater agreement +0.11 kappa on the two subjective concepts we tested, which is exactly the mechanism the deliberation framework is meant to exercise.

Risk: at full 400M scale the faiss-gpu index doesn't fit a single card; we're testing a sharded index across the 4 A100s. If that stalls, fallback is faiss-cpu with ~6x slower retrieval, which the rater UI can absorb but won't enjoy.

Yusuf
